text:
maria: Heads-up — drafting a compact release blurb for the Adaptive routing change. Needs: 1) short what's-new bullet 2) a note about canary fallback behavior (known issue: small perf regression in 512 tokens on T4s) 3) SDK snippet (python + node) 4) links to rollout plan. I'll push a PR to the docs repo in ~30m. pinging for reviewers: @oliver @sasha

oliver: Thanks! Can you include the new config flag name? It's adaptive_routing.enabled -> we should call that out. Also add the fallback chain order (hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-tier) so ops understand.

sasha: I can do SDK snippets. Prefer to show both sync and streaming examples. Will draft python snippet and a terse node streaming snippet.

zack: QA ask — please add a clear 'Known issues' bullet with a repro note and a staging link. Also a one-line changelog bullet for the what's-new feed.

ben: Also watch link health — last time we broke embed-streaming redirect. I'll run linkcheck after merge and can add redirects if needed.

docs-ci: PR #4821 — staging linkcheck report: 2 404s (/examples/old-sdk, /tutorials/routing-old), 1 lint warning (long line in docs/adaptive-routing.md).

maria: Thanks all. I'll include the redirect and fix the lint. Draft blurb below — feel free to copy-edit.

maria: ```
What's new — Adaptive routing (beta)
- Adaptive routing lets requests prefer lower-cost model variants while preserving output quality via automated fallbacks.
- Opt-in: set adaptive_routing.enabled = true for a route or model binding.
- Fallback order: hosted -> dedicated -> fallback-tier (configurable).
Known issues:
- On some T4 machines, we observe a small ~5-10ms overhead at sequence length 512 when the KV cache warms; mitigation: pin model variant or disable adaptive_routing for latency-critical routes.

Quick SDK snippets:
Python (sync):
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Tell me a joke", model="rodeo-3", routing={"adaptive_routing": {"enabled": True}})
print(resp.text)

Node (streaming):
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')
const r = new Redwood();
for await (const chunk of r.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'Summarize the doc', model: 'rodeo-3', routing: { adaptive_routing: { enabled: true }}})) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

sasha: snippets look good, I pushed a small tweak to the python example to use the client context manager pattern. Also added a one-line node example (non-streaming) for the changelog page.

oliver: Quick copy edit: replace 'fallback-tier' with 'fallback-tier (lightweight variant pool)' and remove the parenthetical in the first bullet. Otherwise LGTM.

maria: updated in PR, added redirect from /docs/old-routing -> /docs/adaptive-routing/ and a staging preview link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing/preview-4821

ben: Running linkcheck now...

docs-ci: Linkcheck (staging preview-4821) — 0 404s, 0 lint errors, 1 warning (long line in example block). Full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/4821/linkcheck

maria: Great, will shorten the long line. Planning to merge in ~10m. Can someone watch the release notes index to confirm the blurb renders correctly?

sasha: I'll watch and adjust CSS escapes if needed.

zack: +1 — I'll verify the known-issues anchor and add the changelog bullet to the What's New feed after merge.

maria: Thanks everyone — merging now. If any regressions appear, we'll revert and ship a patch with rollback notes. :thumbsup:
